title: Bass drum sizes for dances and parades
summary: He gives typical bass drum sizes, his own 16 by 30, and the narrower drums colored parade drummers used.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: So I'm trying to ask about the bass drum. How big a bass drum did they use in the old days?

big drums or smaller drums? Well for the dance jobs they used the bigger drums. They ran anywhere from 12 inches to 16. I had a 16 by 30. About 30 inches and really a big drum. And 16 inches wide. But the standard was the 1428. But for parades, some of the guys used to use these little narrow things about 8 inches, about 28. You know most of the colored fellas used those.
They still used about 28 on the parades.
